stage_b.name: grouped_headmix4_residual64_reader_r16_answerkl_gemma3_4b_to_qwen3_4b_mix4_seed1234
stage_b.stage_a_selection: Reuse frozen grouped Stage-A best.pt; do not use previous fully tuned Stage-B
stage_b.stage_b_selection: Fixed epoch4 step1024 last checkpoint, never test-selected
stage_b.stage_b_objective: Same UFD full-vocabulary forward KL and mixed prefixes. Freeze Stage-A translator and both LLMs. Train only zero-up per-target-layer CROSS-HEAD rank64 K/V residuals; no Reader.
caveats: Same grouped Stage-A and Stage-B data/objective/budget as full-translator run; trainable scope and residual parameterization change together.
Stage-B residuals mix heads within each target layer; source-layer grouping remains in the frozen translator.
Reuse historical evaluation subsets and Full-Sync accuracy interface; no zero-prefill latency claim.

reader.name: grouped_headmix4_residual64_reader_r16_answerkl_gemma3_4b_to_qwen3_4b_mix4_seed1234
reader.loss: Full-vocabulary forward KL(Native||StageA+Residual+Reader), temperature1, FP32 loss. MCQ: ONLY answer-label prediction boundary, all labels audited single-token. GSM8K: unchanged up-to8 positions in max64-token same-prefix continuation. Equal example weighting. No gold CE or reward.
reader.prefix_sampling: Same parent balanced question order. MCQ has no generated answer prefix or rollout. GSM8K epoch1 native prefixes; epochs2-4 one native and one online Student example per batch. Teacher always scores identical histories with Reader disabled.
reader.interface: Frozen grouped Stage-A best.pt + frozen cross-head residual Stage-B last.pt, both pinned by SHA256. Fresh all36 Q/O LoRA; no old Reader weights. Native teacher/prefill Reader disabled; only translated-cache suffix/continuation enables Reader.
reader.selection: Primary fixed epoch4/step1024. Keep epoch1/2/3/4 Reader checkpoints. Best macro validation KL checkpoint is diagnostic only, never test-selected.
reader.validation_task_metrics: On fixed16 validation rows/task: KL plus same-prefix next-token agreement for all4 tasks; label accuracy on3 MCQ tasks. Full GSM8K free-generation accuracy only in final test, using unchanged4096 cap.
caveats: Sender and Stage-A data mixture both differ from the Llama run; not a sender-only ablation.
Stage A uses the same four-task train512each and validation64each rows as B/Reader, without answers or CoT in the input.
MMLU-Pro remains the existing custom split of official test.
Full-Sync accuracy interface; no prefill-free latency claim.

config.source_cache_policy: Train/validation source shared by A/B/Reader; deterministic Qwen reconstruction targets computed on demand. Delete ONLY own regenerable train/validation source caches after all three training completion gates, before test capture.

training_supervision: Post-k_norm pre-RoPE K and V; NMSE+cosine; source prompt has no appended answers or CoT.
stage_a_data: Same four-task512each train and64each validation as B/Reader, same IDs; no test data.
caveats: Sender and Stage-A data mixture both differ from the Llama run; not a sender-only ablation.
Stage A uses the same four-task train512each and validation64each rows as B/Reader, without answers or CoT in the input.
MMLU-Pro remains the existing custom split of official test.
Full-Sync accuracy interface; no prefill-free latency claim.
